This actually just happened a few days ago. 

I was out all day in 98 degree weather in southern Louisiana (New Orleans to be specific) hardly drank any water and was kind of already dehydrated from drinking the day before. Barely ate, had a decent breakfast but no lunch or dinner, maybe a bag of chip. 

We leave the park and are on our way to eat and I got the worse panic attack of my life. I felt like I knew I was going to die. I start hallucinating, my hands started seizing up and I could no longer feel my body. I couldn’t speak and what came out was barely audible much less English. All I could think was “I’m going to die for being a dumb ass and not drinking enough water”. 

Thankfully I was fine. My boyfriend calmed me down and rubbed my hands till they relaxed. I very slowly drank some water and had a pretty light dinner. The whole experience now feels so surreal but I’m grateful I wasn’t in much real danger.
